purpose: Connect four repository-owned questions as one epistemic chapter sequence without turning them into one software pipeline or transferring claim ownership.
surface: 何を残す？ → 何が隠れる？ → どこまで届く？ → どこを見る？
dependency_rule: chapter order is conceptual/epistemic; no chapter automatically validates or technically depends on the preceding repository output

chapters.question: WHAT belongs in the niche?
chapters.public_line: 環境は、入れただけでは niche にならない。
chapters.current_state: scientific core closed; known-truth support retained; fresh empirical Product A ended empirical_confirmation_not_supported and not_promoted; Product B blocked
chapters.claim_firewall: environmental plausibility, inclusion in a candidate library, or known-truth recovery is not an empirical universal-driver result

chapters.question: HOW THICK is it?
chapters.operation: x-y -> added vertical / temporal / structural / identity axes -> thickness, partition and held-out transferability
chapters.public_line: 地図は、niche を薄くする。
chapters.current_state: multidimensional niche-geometry chapter with one prospectively unresolved temporal lane. The completed bat lane recovered descriptive vertical thickness (effective states ≈4.02) but its x-y-conditioned vertical organization did not generalize to either sealed individual. A separate Snapshot Serengeti contract now tests temporal thickness H(T|Site), temporal partition I(Species;T|Site), and three held-out site-fold gains; its terminal outcome has not yet been opened.
chapters.claim_firewall: thickness != transferable organization; temporal thickness != identity partition; identity-time association != competition or causal displacement; camera detection time != automatically true activity-time niche. Historical ODSP topology remains superseded by EOG.

chapters.question: WHERE can it become real?
chapters.operation: local possibility -> compatible transition/distribution worlds -> reachability/realizability
chapters.public_line: 住める場所と、辿り着ける場所は違う。
chapters.current_state: two favorable fresh heterogeneous paired endpoints support a replicated candidate general predictive complement; one valid third endpoint remains before paper-level closure
chapters.claim_firewall: compatible world is not true history; local support is not realized distribution; current evidence is not universal superiority

chapters.question: WHERE can we justify looking next?
chapters.operation: support/world evidence -> bounded survey candidate patches
chapters.public_line: 予測の終点は、次の観測の入口になる。
chapters.current_state: validated Japanese 2.5% robust-support candidate-patch product; country-framed promotion failed preregistered gates; paper closed at bounded Japanese claim
chapters.claim_firewall: candidate patch is not occupancy probability, exact occupied site, route/budget optimum, or validated global product

handoffs: SDMR to ODSP: from which environmental dimensions deserve representation to how much state information a flat representation discards
ODSP to EOG: from local multidimensional support geometry to whether locally possible states are reachable and distributionally realizable under multiple worlds
EOG to ACSP: from uncertain compatible worlds to a bounded decision about where additional field observation is justified
non_handoffs: ODSP does not modify or rescue SDMR Product A
the Snapshot Serengeti temporal lane is independent of the completed Tawaki and bat endpoints and cannot retune or rescue them
EOG does not require ODSP output and owns the historical ODSP topology component separately
ACSP does not require EOG and its validated Japanese patch rule was independently confirmed under its own contract
a favorable later chapter cannot retroactively promote a failed or blocked earlier chapter
